episodes.title: The Emperor's Peace
episodes.summary: Gaal Dornick leaves her life in Synnax behind when the galaxy's greatest mathematician, Hari Seldon, invites her to Trantor.

episodes.title: Preparing to Live
episodes.summary: The Foundation makes the long journey to Terminus as Gaal and Raych grow closer. The Empire faces a difficult decision.

episodes.title: The Mathematician's Ghost
episodes.summary: Brother Dusk reflects on his legacy as he prepares for ascension. The Foundation arrives on Terminus and finds a mysterious object.

episodes.title: Barbarians at the Gate
episodes.summary: Salvor faces off with an enemy of the Empire. Brothers Day and Dusk are at odds, while Brother Dawn wrestles with his truth.

episodes.title: Upon Awakening
episodes.summary: A flashback reveals the origin of Gaal's conflict between faith and science. The standoff on Terminus takes an unfortunate turn.

episodes.title: Death and the Maiden
episodes.summary: Brother Day meets Zephyr Halima—a would-be leader who opposes the Empire. Brother Dusk grows suspicious of Brother Dawn.

episodes.title: Mysteries and Martyrs
episodes.summary: The Anacreons and their hostages board the fabled Invictus warship. The bond between Brother Dawn and Azura intensifies.

episodes.title: The Missing Piece
episodes.summary: Brother Day embarks on a journey that no other Cleon has ever attempted. Salvor prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice to return home.

episodes.title: The First Crisis
episodes.summary: On Terminus, Salvor witnesses how powerful the null field has become. Brother Dawn makes a daring choice.

episodes.title: The Leap
episodes.summary: An unexpected ally helps Salvor broker an alliance. A confrontation between the Brothers leads to unthinkable consequences.

episodes.title: In Seldon's Shadow
episodes.summary: Hari finds himself trapped in a mysterious prison. An assassination attempt leaves Day shaken. Gaal and Salvor devise an escape plan.

episodes.title: A Glimpse of Darkness
episodes.summary: Gaal has a disturbing vision. Day's bond with Queen Sareth grows stronger. The Vault opens and reveals a cryptic message.

episodes.title: King and Commoner
episodes.summary: The Empire recruits Bel Riose to investigate the resurgent Foundation. Hari leads Gaal and Salvor to a desert planet.

episodes.title: Where the Stars Are Scattered Thinly
episodes.summary: Queen Sareth and Dawn share a moment as she tries to learn more about Day. Brothers Constant and Poly bring Hober Mallow to Terminus.

episodes.title: The Sighted and the Seen
episodes.summary: Gaal, Salvor, and Hari arrive on Ignis and meet the source of the strange signal they've been tracking. Dawn and Dusk are suspicious of Day.

episodes.title: Why the Gods Made Wine
episodes.summary: Day and Queen Sareth make an announcement. Tellem sows seeds of distrust between Gaal and Hari. Hober Mallow reaches his destination.

episodes.title: A Necessary Death
episodes.summary: Salvor begins to question the Mentalics' motives. Hober Mallow's proposal to the Spacers meets resistance. Brothers Constant and Poly stand trial.

episodes.title: The Last Empress
episodes.summary: Enjoiner Rue confides in Dusk about her distrust of Demerzel. Hober Mallow pulls a daring move. Day sets course for Terminus and the Foundation.

episodes.title: Long Ago, Not Far Away
episodes.summary: Dusk and Enjoiner Rue learn Demerzel's origin and true purpose. Tellem's plans for Gaal take a dark turn. On Terminus, Day confronts Dr. Seldon.

episodes.title: Creation Myths
episodes.summary: Season finale. Gaal, Salvor, and Hari chart a new path forward on Ignis. Demerzel heads to Trantor, taking actions that will change Empire forever.

episodes.title: A Song for the End of Everything
episodes.summary: A mysterious new pirate with terrifying abilities—known as the Mule—catches the attention of the Foundation and Empire.

episodes.title: Shadows in the Math
episodes.summary: Gaal and Hari advance their plans on Ignis. Empire grapples with an unforeseen prediction. Pritcher enlists help to investigate the Mule.

episodes.title: When a Book Finds You
episodes.summary: An unexpected alliance is formed. Pritcher, Bayta, and Toran come face-to-face with the Mule. Demerzel seeks spiritual guidance.

episodes.title: The Stress of Her Regard
episodes.summary: Demerzel struggles with the paradox of her programming. Pritcher's true loyalties are revealed. Day sets off on a quest for answers.

episodes.title: Where Tyrants Spend Eternity
episodes.summary: Day enters uncharted territory. Dawn and Gaal put their plan in motion. Magnifico's worth becomes clear. Demerzel attempts to restore power.

episodes.title: The Shape of Time
episodes.summary: A long-awaited reunion turns violent. Day looks for Song. On New Terminus, the Vault opens—and the Mule takes aim.

episodes.title: Foundation's End
episodes.summary: Chaos and destruction rain down on New Terminus. Back on Trantor, Dusk and Quent unite to assess the state of the galaxy.

episodes.title: Skin in the Game
episodes.summary: Gaal and the Second Foundation reckon with the fall of New Terminus. Day faces judgment on Mycogen. Dusk's ascension looms.

episodes.title: The Paths That Choose Us
episodes.summary: Gaal confronts the power of the Mule's conversions. Dusk resorts to drastic measures. Demerzel searches for clarity about the future.

episodes.title: The Darkness
episodes.summary: Season finale. Gaal and the Second Foundation take the fight to the Mule as Empire's legacy suffers a catastrophic blow.
